body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> TRITTON Technologies debuted its new flagship 3D directional gaming headset 'AX Pro' at CES 2009.

The AX Pro is fully armed with true Dolby Digital 5.1 surround sound, illuminated in-line volume adjustment for Front, Center, Rear and Subwoofer controls, and an awesome eight independent speaker configuration.

The AX Pro is extremely light weight and features an ergonomic design that emphasizes comfort, even during marathon gaming sessions. The headset is equipped with a detachable microphone for online PC, Mac, Xbox Live and PlayStation Network gamers, enabling clear voice communication with other players. The AX Pro allows video game players to fully absorb ultra-detailed sound elements, such as the thunder of machine gun fire, an opponent sneaking up from behind, or the pulsating whine of a fellow racer's car trying to make a pass. The AX Pro also allows users to enjoy their favorite movies in Dolby Digital 5.1 or Dolby Pro Logic without disturbing others.
